about_short_description.short_description: CAMP is a provider of aviation management products and services including aircraft maintenance tracking and information.

product.name: CAMP Maintenance Management (MTX)
product.description: A system to track, plan, and manage scheduled and predictive maintenance for aircraft.

product.name: CAMP Engine Health Monitoring (EHM)
product.description: A service that monitors engine health and performance to detect issues early and support predictive maintenance.

product.name: CAMP Inventory Management System (IMS)
product.description: A web-based tool to track and manage aircraft parts inventory, including procurement, warranty, and documentation.

product.name: CAMP Flight Scheduling (FS)
product.description: A tool to plan and manage flight schedules for aircraft operations.

product.name: iCAMP Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app providing remote access to aircraft status, maintenance workflows, and flight data insights.

product.name: Aircraft Insights
product.description: A module that analyzes flight data to provide performance and operational insights for aircraft.
